This healthy curry is popular for its mild flavor and moderate spiciness.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Vegetable Curries are made by [[Cooking]] [[Hylian Rice]], [[Goron Spice]], and either a [[Fortified Pumpkin]], [[Swift Carrot]], or [[Endura Carrot]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made by using multiple [[Vegetable]]s with differing effects. Eating them will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. These Curries are healthy, and their mild flavor and spiciness make them popular. Based on the type of Vegetable used, Link can make the following variations of Vegetable Curry: * '''Enduring Vegetable Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Vegetable Curry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This healthy curry is popular for its mild flavor and moderate spiciness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using Endura Carrots. When eaten, these curries will completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Vegetable Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Vegetable Curry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This healthy curry is popular for its mild flavor and moderate spiciness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using Swift Carrots. By eating them, Link will receive a boost to his movement speed. * '''Tough Vegetable Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Vegetable Curry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This healthy curry is popular for its mild flavor and moderate spiciness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using Fortified Pumpkins. They can be eaten to grant Link a boost to his defense. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} [[Link]] can make Vegetable Curry by [[Cooking]] either type of [[Pumpkin]] or [[Carrot]] with a bundle of [[Hylian Rice]] and [[Goron Spice]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Curry Rice * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Curries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
